name: Osteosarcoma
definition: High-grade primary malignant bone-forming tumor, commonly affecting metaphyseal regions around the knee in adolescents and young adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI of the entire involved bone plus staging are standard; biopsy must be sarcoma-team planned.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Do not perform unplanned biopsy or excision.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikara framework may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: High-grade primary malignant bone-forming tumor, commonly affecting metaphyseal regions around the knee in adolescents and young adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
